purpose: Prevent superseded visual experiments from being treated as current Valoria production inputs while preserving historical evidence.
protected_current: closed production-family sources and their evidence
rules: Historical-only paths are not valid production authority or runtime input.
Do not dispatch historical-only workflows for Valoria production without explicit owner reauthorization.
Do not delete historical evidence solely to make the repository smaller.
If a historical file is referenced by current production, classify it before any mutation; ambiguity means keep.
Current WebGL mobile playtest scope is excluded from cleanup.
deletion_policy: No physical deletion in this pass because AGENTS.md explicitly requires rejected Camera-First evidence to be preserved and current dependency proof is incomplete. Cleanup is quarantine/classification, not destructive erasure.
